decision: Does fixed-rank source pooling over three non-target label tasks reduce transferred query error and satisfy both strict dense-pair criteria?

hypotheses.H1: Pooling broadens reusable source directions enough to lower transferred error at the fixed rank and compact width.
hypotheses.H0: At the same retained rank, pooling does not improve transfer or still fails strict dense-pair fidelity.

validity: Same saved target-task reference, iid pair and observation grid; all source blocks finite orthonormal rank 15; fixed geometry survives resetting only target-label deficit; no constructor truncation; source condition at most 16; old-only rerun differs from saved old-only by at most 0.1 of dense-pair endpoint and separate maximum RMS.
